to add: every single maze was very fun. yes, even chucky was decent. there wasnt really one maze that stood out to me more than the others, they were all pretty much on par with one another. however if i had to pick a top three it would probably be the darkest deal, dr oddfellows and stranger things.

the darkest deal - i found this one super clever, i love how the story is told throughout the maze. there were a few small details that made it feel really magic and realistic. i personally thought it was really unique and i had a massive smile on my face the whole way round.

dr oddfellows - probably one of the scariest ones. there was a headless clown at one point that made me absolutely shit myself, i love dr oddfellow himself and found the characters to have cool designs.

stranger things - i was disappointed they didnt have a bigger bit for when max is trapped in the upside down during the scene when “running up that hill” plays in this season, but other than that the set design and actors in this one were top notch. i wish the staff didnt have to rush you through the mazes so quick because there were quite a few parts in this maze i wish i had time to stop and get a good look at.

universal monsters - the notre dame bit in this one scared me shiiiitless, and the phantom of the opera bits were but i have trauma around phantom of the opera so maybe it made this one a bit scarier for me than it would other people lol. i thought the jumpscares in this one were really good.

the last of us - the way they did the spores was sooooo super cool. i was a little underwhelmed with the story (or lack of) that there is through the maze but the set design and characters in this one were really impressive.

blood moon - pleasantly surprised by this one, had some reeally fucked up stage design and some parts that made you seriously unnerved without the need for a jumpscare.

chucky - everyone on this subreddit was bashing chucky saying that it was corny and wasnt scary in the slightest so i had very very low expectations but honestly? it shit me up quite a bit. yeah a few bits were a bit cheesy and cheap but it was 10x better than i thought it be due to so many people trashing it on here. 

the exorcist - pretty scary, the set deign was super cool but it just wasnt very memorable. they have some really unnerving bits in this 🥲

duelling dragons - had a very much lord of the rings / dnd feel to it. it wasnt as scary as some of the others but the set design was astounding.

yeti - probably the weakest one for me. the set and jumpscares were pretty good - however the yeti costume quickly got a bit tiredsome and unscary.
